title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Fitzpatrick Leads French Open
items.text: Matt Fitzpatrick shot 6-under 65 Saturday at Le Golf National to gain a five-shot lead in the Open de France, chasing his fourth title of 2026.

items.headline: Fleetwood Withdraws from French Open
items.text: Tommy Fleetwood withdrew from the $3.75M Open de France due to sudden illness while 6-under, removing a contender before the final round.

items.headline: Presidents Cup Sweeps USA
items.text: After two days at Medinah, Team USA suffered a rare sweep at the Presidents Cup, marking a major turn in the competition.
